title: Brightstar Lottery's Cash Pop Game Launched in Canada with the Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation
summary: LONDON , Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) ("Brightstar") announced today that Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation
body_markdown:
LONDON


, Oct. 26, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) ("Brightstar") announced today that Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation ("OLG") has launched Brightstar's Cash Pop™ draw-based game, becoming the first lottery jurisdiction in Canada to offer the game. The Cash Pop game features five daily draws and provides players with multiple price points and opportunities to customize their play experience.


*"Introducing Brightstar's Cash Pop game in Ontario allows OLG to bring a proven, innovative game to players while continuing to evolve our lottery portfolio,"* said **Andrew Darley, OLG Vice President, Lottery Product.** *"As the first lottery jurisdiction in Canada to offer the Cash Pop game, we're excited to expand player choice with a unique draw-based game while continuing to give back to communities across Ontario."*


*"We're thrilled to introduce our proprietary Cash Pop game to Ontario through this partnership with OLG,"* said **Scott Gunn, Brightstar Chief Operating Officer North America.** *"The game's innovative format has resonated with players across multiple jurisdictions, and we look forward to supporting OLG as it continues delivering engaging lottery experiences."*


The Cash Pop game is a fresh and innovative draw game that offers easy-to-play game mechanics, enabling players to create their own personalized experience every time they play. This proven game concept has demonstrated highly engaging appeal amongst players where it is offered.


**About Brightstar Lottery PLC** Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) is a global leader in lottery focused on innovation and forward-thinking strategies and solutions, building on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a premier pure play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, entertain players and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. Brightstar has a well-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility. Brightstar serves nearly 90 lottery customers and their players on six continents. It is the primary technology provider to 26 of the 46 lottery jurisdictions in the U.S. and eight of the world's 10 largest lotteries with central systems. Brightstar has approximately 6,000 employees.
